architectural_units.name: Client
architectural_units.description: The client is the user of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for displaying information to the user.

architectural_units.name: Business Layer
architectural_units.description: This layer is the core of the application and is responsible for processing all the information.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for storing all the data.

architectural_units.name: API Gateway
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for the management, authentication and authorization of platform users.

architectural_units.name: Core
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for performing the business logic of the platform, it would be the main core of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Analytical Module
architectural_units.description: This service has the main function of obtaining and processing data from playlogs, connections and platform actions.

architectural_units.name: API Player
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for communicating with the players by receiving all the information corresponding to it.

architectural_units.name: Web Socket
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for carrying out the communication between the platform and the players, and in this way allows the exchange of information between them.

architectural_units.name: MySQL
architectural_units.description: The database used is a MySQL database that is responsible for storing all the data necessary for the operation of the system.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: This is the AWS object storage service. In this project it is responsible for storing JSON documents that contain the playlogs, connections and audit trail.

architectural_units.name: DynamoDB
architectural_units.description: This service is a non-relational database from AWS. In our case it is responsible for storing playlogs in real time.

architectural_units.name: NestJS
architectural_units.description: Backend framework used to develop the different services that interact with each other.

architectural_units.name: TypeScript
architectural_units.description: Programming language used for the development of the backend.

architectural_units.name: Amazon Athena
architectural_units.description: The Amazon Athena service is a service that allows SQL queries to be performed on data stored in Amazon S3.

architectural_units.name: AWS Glue
architectural_units.description: AWS Glue is a serverless data integration service that allows us to detect, prepare, migrate and integrate data from different sources.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Streams
architectural_units.description: Kinesis Data Streams is a data processing and ingestion service specifically aimed at data streaming.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
architectural_units.description: The Kinesis Data Firehose service has as its main function the loading of large amounts of data into data warehouses.

architectural_units.name: Player
architectural_units.description: A player consists of a device that can be internal or external, which allows screens to play content.
The presentation layer communicates with the capa de negoci, more specifically with the Api Gateway, using the HTTP protocol.
The Api Gateway processes requests to send them to the Core service and the Analytical Module.
The Core service interacts with the database.
The Analytical Module interacts with the cloud services and the database.
The Web Socket service carries out the communication between the platform and the players, allowing the exchange of information between them.
The Web Socket service processes data from players and stores it in the database and cloud services.
The microservices (Core and Web Socket) send data to the Kinesis Data Stream.
Kinesis Data Firehose reads from the Kinesis Data Stream and stores data in Amazon S3.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: The communication between the two components is carried out through the internet using the HTTP protocol.

architectural_units.name: TCP
architectural_units.description: The communication between the Api Gateway service is through the TCP communication protocol.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: In our project the Waapiti platform is a web service that follows the client-server architecture.

patterns.name: Layered Architecture
patterns.description: For the client-server model, the 3-layer architecture is used, where the system is divided into 3 layers, the presentation layer, the business layer and the data layer.

patterns.name: API Gateway
patterns.description: This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform.
